findings.description: Partial staging creation or sequential cleanup can leave .github_pending missing required files and permanently block retry.
findings.required_change: Build payloads in temporary sibling and atomically rename into .github_pending; after verifiedreceipt atomically rename pending out before cleanup; preserve incomplete leftovers.
findings.resolution: Complete payload staged in a temporary sibling and atomically renamed into pending. After durable verifiedreceipt, pending is atomically retired before cleanup. Regression tests simulate staging crash and cleanup failure; retries succeed.

findings.description: HKDF is not password-hardening for a user-entered32character passphrase. Length alone does not ensure sufficient entropy.
findings.required_change: Use password-hardening KDF with randomsalt, or explicitly require and generate cryptographically random key material.
findings.resolution: AES-256-GCM key uses Scrypt(n32768,r8,p1,length32), random16byte salt, fixed authenticated KDF header. Variable attacker-controlled work factors are rejected before derivation.

findings.description: A new mistyped secret on an existinglocal case can encrypt and publish latestbackup under a differentkey without first authenticating currentremote ciphertext.
findings.required_change: Before first overwrite of existingremote state per storeinstance authenticate currentcipher with providedsecret; wrongkey causes no ref write.
findings.resolution: Existing remote ciphertext is authenticated before pending creation; existing pending ciphertext is also authenticated before any ref write. Wrong remote/pending keys cause zero writes; corrected key retry succeeds.
